data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch data from Google (30-3600 seconds)
data_description.enable_location_tracking: When enabled, each location poll may send a notification to the child's device
data_description.strict_mode: Closes a gap on Google's side that many children know how to use: from the Family Link app or the Google interface, a supervised child can add a time bonus, unlock a device that has no time left, or switch bedtime and the daily limit off. With tamper protection, Home Assistant becomes the single point of control: after every refresh it undoes those changes and restores what you set. WARNING: while it is on, any change made in the Family Link app is undone, even by a parent. Settings are made from Home Assistant. To hand control back to Family Link, turn the child's tamper protection switch (Strict mode) off: it mirrors this option, changing one updates the other.
data_description.strict_mode_rules: What Home Assistant protects: on these points, any change made from Family Link is undone. Nothing is switched on by force, the state chosen in Home Assistant is the reference. Untick a rule to be able to change it from Family Link. Details in the README.
data_description.lock_keeps_allowed_apps: On: a device locked from Home Assistant lets the child open the apps marked "always allowed" in Family Link, through the "Available apps" button of the lock screen (as the Family Link app does when its lock screen setting is ticked). Off: full lock, emergency calls only.
data_description.allowed_users: Leave empty to let every Home Assistant user use the Family Link buttons, switches and settings (the default). Once you tick users here, only they and the administrators can: a child's non-administrator account is refused on every Family Link button, switch, limit, time and select, and on the familylink.* actions. Automations and scripts started by Home Assistant itself are not affected. Give the child a non-administrator account: an administrator can change this option.

manual_url.title: Authentication Server URL
manual_url.description:
No local authentication source was detected. Enter the Family Link Auth server base URL. Any reverse-proxy path prefix is preserved. If the standalone container has API_KEY configured, enter it separately; otherwise leave the key blank.

URL example: `http://192.168.1.100:8099`
